Technology Guidance: Provide technical guidance in evaluating, selecting, and deploying security tools and frameworks. Security Engineering & Automation: Develop and implement security automation and integration across security platforms using scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash). Threat & Vulnerability Management: Work closely with the SOC and threat teams to identify, analyze, and remediate security risks. Compliance & Governance: Ensure security solutions align with regulatory requirements. Incident Response Support: Provide advanced security engineering support for security incidents and investigations, including root cause analysis and remediation strategies. Security Program Ownership: Lead and contribute to large-scale security projects and initiatives, ensuring proper documentation, risk assessments, and successful implementation. Research & Development: Stay ahead of emerging threats, security technologies, and industry trends to continuously enhance security posture. Mentorship & Training: Mentor security engineers and provide knowledge sharing through documentation, training sessions, and hands-on guidance. Strong expertise in security technologies, including: Next Generation Firewalls (NGFW) Web Application Firewall (WAF) must have F5 experience Privileged Access Management (PAM) must have CyberArk experience Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Single Sign-On (SSO) & Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Security Information & Event Management (SIEM) Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) Identity & Access Management (IAM) Network segmentation & Zero Trust architectures Deep knowledge of Networking, NGFW, WAF, macro segmentation, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern security frameworks (e.g., Zero Trust, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, ISO 27001). Proven experience with automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for security engineering and threat detection. Strong experience in security architecture and solution design for enterprise environments. Experience with performing risk assessments, threat modeling, and security controls validation. Advanced knowledge of compliance. Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to translate security concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Professional security certifications preferred: CISSP, OSCP, CISM, CEH, GSEC, or equivalent. review_candidates.description: Role Description We are seeking technically skilled and detail-oriented professionals for the positions of DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer. These roles focus on improving software delivery processes, managing cloud infrastructure, automating operational workflows, and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure technology environments. Successful candidates will contribute to infrastructure optimization, system performance, deployment automation, and the implementation of modern cloud technologies. DevOps Engineers are responsible for streamlining software development and deployment processes through automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices. Key duties include developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure configuration, managing deployment workflows, monitoring application performance, and troubleshooting system issues. They collaborate with software development, quality assurance, and operations teams to improve release efficiency, strengthen system reliability, and establish consistent deployment procedures. They also support version control, containerization, infrastructure automation, and operational monitoring. Cloud Engineers focus on designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing cloud-based infrastructure and services. Responsibilities include configuring cloud resources, maintaining virtual networks and storage systems, managing access permissions, monitoring resource utilization, and supporting cloud migration initiatives. They help ensure infrastructure availability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency while implementing backup, recovery, and disaster preparedness measures. They also evaluate cloud services, resolve infrastructure issues, and maintain technical documentation to support reliable operations. Both roles require strong technical problem-solving abilities, an understanding of modern infrastructure practices, and a commitment to automation, security, and continuous improvement. Professionals in these positions work closely with technical teams to enhance system performance, reduce operational complexity, and support dependable digital services. Qualifications Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, or a related technical discipline. Understanding of Linux or Windows server administration, networking fundamentals, and system architecture. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, automated deployment, and infrastructure management. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Go. Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation, is an advantage. Understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery principles. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and organizational skills. Effective communication and collaboration abilities, with a commitment to system reliability, automation, and continuous improvement.
